file_description: Well Production - Monthly well-level production data (all years)
data_format: WIDE format - one row per well-month

extraction_method_descriptions.mechanical_pump: Sucker rod pump (beam pump, walking beam) - most common artificial lift. Surface unit drives subsurface pump via reciprocating sucker rods. Suitable for low-medium rates, high viscosity. Typical depth: 500-3000m.
extraction_method_descriptions.electric_submersible_pump_esp: ESP - electric motor-driven multistage centrifugal pump installed downhole. High-volume lift, handles water, temperature-limited. Typical: 500-5000 bpd, depth to 3000m.
extraction_method_descriptions.progressive_cavity_pump_pcp: PCP - positive displacement pump with helical rotor rotating inside elastomer stator. Excellent for viscous oil, sand production. Handles 10-2000 bpd.
extraction_method_descriptions.gas_lift: Inject high-pressure gas into production tubing to lighten fluid column and enable flow. Versatile, reliable, handles high volumes. Requires gas availability and compression.
extraction_method_descriptions.natural_flow: Well flows naturally without artificial lift - reservoir pressure sufficient to overcome wellbore pressure and surface backpressure. Most economical but typically depletes over time.
extraction_method_descriptions.plunger_lift: Free-traveling piston (plunger) cycles up and down tubing to lift liquids. Used in gas wells with liquid loading. Intermittent flow, low maintenance.
extraction_method_descriptions.other_artificial_lift: Other methods: hydraulic pump, jet pump, or hybrid systems. Less common, specialized applications.
extraction_method_descriptions.no_artificial_lift: Well not equipped with lift system - may be shut-in, under evaluation, or awaiting installation.

well_status_descriptions.producing: Well actively producing oil or gas - normal operations
well_status_descriptions.producing_equipment_issues: Producing but with equipment problems - reduced efficiency, repair needed
well_status_descriptions.producing_operational_issues: Producing but with operational problems - well performance issues, not equipment
well_status_descriptions.injecting_active: Well actively injecting fluids - water, gas, or CO2
well_status_descriptions.water_injection_active: Active water injection for pressure maintenance (waterflooding) or disposal
well_status_descriptions.gas_injection_active: Active gas injection for pressure maintenance, gas cycling, or EOR
well_status_descriptions.co2_injection_active: Active CO2 injection for EOR (miscible flooding) or storage/sequestration
well_status_descriptions.waiting_completion: Drilled well waiting for completion, stimulation, or tie-in
well_status_descriptions.under_evaluation: Well status under evaluation - testing, analysis, or decision pending
well_status_descriptions.shut_in_gas_reserve: Gas well capable of production but held in reserve - market conditions or regulatory
well_status_descriptions.shut_in_oil_reserve: Oil well capable of production but held in reserve - economic or regulatory
well_status_descriptions.permanently_abandoned: Well permanently plugged and abandoned per regulations - no future use
well_status_descriptions.temporarily_suspended: Production temporarily suspended - market, maintenance, or operational reasons
well_status_descriptions.temporarily_plugged: Well temporarily plugged - can be restored to production if needed

unit_notes.m3: Cubic meters - volume for oil and water
unit_notes.km3: Thousand cubic meters (km3) = 10^3 m3 - volume for gas (NOTE: different from Mm3 in field production!)
unit_notes.important: Well production uses km3 for gas, field production uses Mm3 - be careful!

technical_notes.artificial_lift_selection: Lift method depends on: reservoir depth, fluid properties (viscosity, gas content), production rate, water cut, sand production, and economic factors
technical_notes.esp_advantages: High volume capability, good for high water cut, relatively efficient
technical_notes.esp_limitations: Temperature-sensitive (elastomers), gas handling issues, electricity required downhole
technical_notes.pcp_advantages: Handles viscous oil, sand, and solids well, good efficiency
technical_notes.gas_lift_advantages: Versatile, reliable, handles wide range of rates, good for deep wells
technical_notes.mechanical_pump_advantages: Simple, robust, widely applicable, easy to service, handles viscous oil
